title: Classic Fatigue Resistance Long Run Routine
summary: Structured Marathon workout focusing on tempo stamina, long run quality, marathon effort, fueling practice, fatigue resistance.
riskReason: Structured pacing ensures safe muscular adaptation. Maintain proper hydration and dynamic warmup.

warmup.name: Dynamic Warmup
warmup.description: Easy jogging at RPE 3-4 followed by dynamic drills and light progressive strides.
notes: Begin very easy
Focus on high-cadence strides
Prepare joints and cardiovascular system

mainSet.name: Marathon THRESHOLD Interval Segment
mainSet.description: Run repetitions of 16000m at target Marathon Pace / Steady-State Aerobic intensity.
notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 5 repeats.
Focus on clean running form and loose shoulders.
Use the 240s recovery to lower heart rate curves.

cooldown.name: Recovery Cooldown
cooldown.description: Light recovery jog followed by static stretching and mobility reset.
notes: Bring heart rate down completely
Perform dynamic stretches
Rehydrate immediately

easier.description: Reduce interval volume by running 3 repetitions.

mainSet.name: Marathon THRESHOLD Interval Segment
mainSet.description: Easier version: reduced volume to 3 reps.
notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 5 repeats.
Focus on clean running form and loose shoulders.
Use the 240s recovery to lower heart rate curves.

harder.description: Increase interval volume by running 6 repetitions.

mainSet.name: Marathon THRESHOLD Interval Segment
mainSet.description: Harder version: increased volume to 6 reps.
notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 5 repeats.
Focus on clean running form and loose shoulders.
Use the 240s recovery to lower heart rate curves.

coachingNotes: Build marathon pace stamina, steady aerobic capacity, and fatigue resistance.
Keep the intervals strictly at target marathon pace (not faster).
Use float recoveries to teach the body to clear lactate at marathon effort levels.
commonMistakes: Running the tempo blocks too fast, turning an aerobic session into a race.
Skipping hydration/fuel practice on extended steady runs.
Starting the workout with insufficient carbohydrate fuel stores.
safetyNotes: Practice proper fueling and sodium replacement on runs exceeding 90 minutes.
Listen to physical fatigue signals on progressive volume long runs.
Wear premium running shoes with adequate structural support.
